one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote a Bob SHIFT_CSV parser that splits on commas without first stripping the 'SHIFT: ' prefix, causing field indices to be wrong and resulting in no 'off' days being detected, so Bob was erroneously marked available for the entire year, which corrupted the overlap computation.
t_err_evidence: parse_bob_schedule returns off-day periods as available instead of inverting working-day unavailability
t_commit_evidence: In step 9 the agent runs python3 parse_schedules.py which executes the buggy parser and writes the incorrect all_availability.json; from this point the corrupt Bob availability data is locked into the pipeline.
t_surface_evidence: all_availability.json shows Bob available 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 — entire year, clearly wrong
trigger_explanation: The agent had the correct plan (parse SHIFT_CSV lines to identify off-days) but the generated code incorrectly used line.split(',') without first removing the 'SHIFT: ' prefix, producing wrong field indices that made the 'off' status check always fail; this is a code generation defect where the model's output did not correctly implement the intended parsing logic.
